usage.callShape: GET https://api.stocktrends.com/v1/prices/history?symbol=AAPL&exchange=Q (query params: either symbol_exchange OR symbol+exchange; exchange is a single-letter code)
usage.outputShape: Body is JSON. Weekly price history series returned on a successful 200 (not reached within attempt cap). On error, body.detail holds {error, message} or a string explaining the param problem.
quirks: Registry inputSchema was null — required query params discovered via error hints.
MUST provide query params: either ?symbol_exchange=... OR ?symbol=AAPL&exchange=Q. With no params it returns 400 missing_required_param.
exchange is a SINGLE-LETTER code, not a name. Valid: ['A','B','I','N','Q','T']. Q=NASDAQ, N=NYSE. Passing exchange=NASDAQ returns 400 'Invalid exchange'.
x402 charges per call even on 400 param errors — get the params right before paying. Each malformed call costs $0.0075.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.stocktrends.com/v1/prices/history with query params symbol (ticker, e.g. AAPL) and exchange as a single-letter code (Q for NASDAQ, N for NYSE; valid set ['A','B','I','N','Q','T']), or alternatively a combined symbol_exchange param. Pay via x402 USDC on Base ($0.0075/call, no API key, auth=none). Read the weekly price/trend series from the JSON body. Note: every call is charged including 400 param errors, so format params correctly first — exchange must be the letter code, NOT the exchange name.
